using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
using JSON3
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

function cuda_kernel_partialdot_b_1!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(2 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    __cse_0 = lossb[1]
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + v[i_x] * __cse_0
    vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + u[i_x] * __cse_0
    return nothing
end

function partialdot_b_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, i_n)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            loss[1] = loss[1] + mapreduce(((__mr_1, __mr_2)->__mr_1 * __mr_2), +, view(u, 2:i_n), view(v, 2:i_n))
        end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(2 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_partialdot_b_1!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    return nothing
end


function main()
    n = 8
    uh = collect(1.0:n); vh = fill(2.0, n)
    # the loop the kernel actually writes: 2:n
    truth = sum(uh[2:n] .* vh[2:n])
    whole = sum(uh .* vh)
    u = CUDA.CuArray(uh); ub = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n)
    v = CUDA.CuArray(vh); vb = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n)
    loss = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 1); lossb = CUDA.ones(Float64, 1)
    r = Dict{String,Any}("device" => CUDA.name(CUDA.device()),
                         "truth_loop_2_to_n" => truth, "whole_array" => whole)
    try
        partialdot_b_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, n); CUDA.synchronize()
        got = Array(loss)[1]
        r["gpu_loss"] = got
        r["matches_loop"]  = isapprox(got, truth; rtol = 1e-14)
        r["matches_whole"] = isapprox(got, whole; rtol = 1e-14)
        # ub must be zero at index 1 and v elsewhere: the loop skips index 1
        r["ub"] = Array(ub)
        r["status"] = "ok"
    catch e
        r["status"] = "ERR: " * first(sprint(showerror, e), 200)
    end
    println(JSON3.write(r))
end
main()
